en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David.

zh: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉。

ja: 指揮者のために。「マハラテ」に合わせて。ダビデによる黙想の詩。

p.src: 1  The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

en: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.
u.src: 1  The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

p.src: 2  God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

en: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
u.src: 2  God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

p.src: 3  Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

ja: らはみな背を向けた。 ともに
en: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
u.src: 3  Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

p.src: 4  Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
u.src: 4  Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

p.src: 5  There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

ja: らされたからだ。 あなたは
en: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
u.src: 5  There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

p.src: 6  Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

ja: 囚から連れ戻されるとき、 ヤコブは
en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
u.src: 6  Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
